records.title: Synthetic Functional finding: Verify author Story metadata and acceptance
records.message:
Synthetic sample, not a production incident. As a QA engineer, I want to author Story metadata and acceptance so that the reviewed behavior and its failure boundaries are traceable.

Behavior: Save title, priority, owner, labels, effort and a Gherkin or Spec Kit specification; reopen the Story.
Outcome: Every authored value and acceptance criterion is retained without changing another project.

Synthetic acceptance data; configure real dependencies before live execution.

Preconditions: an authorized synthetic session, selected application and reviewed provider readiness.
records.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Confirm the selected web fixture and provider readiness
2. Save title, priority, owner, labels, effort and a Gherkin or Spec Kit specification; reopen the Story.
3. Inspect the observable outcome and capture permitted evidence
4. Reopen the saved record or repeat the documented operation
records.expected_result: Every authored value and acceptance criterion is retained without changing another project.
records.actual_result: Synthetic review fixture demonstrates the missing functional acceptance evidence. No live result is claimed.
